title: Solar-powered irrigation system offered to Ilocos Norte farmers

blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur— The Philippine Rice Research Institute in Batac, Ilocos Norte, is promoting a mobile solar-powered irrigation system to help farmers cut costs and cope with water shortages amid El Niño. The Lakbay Palay 2026 roadshow featured the technology on Oct. 8 in Batac, with the institute helping farmers manage limited water resources during dry spells. Developed by PhilRice Batac’s Agriculture and Biosystems Engineering Unit, the system uses solar energy to pump water, reducing the farmers’ dependence on gasoline- and diesel-powered equipment and electricity.
